name: http-attack
description: Adversarial probes against an HTTP API running on this machine: malformed input, parser errors, races, injection, database faults, missing auth, IDOR and CSRF.
author: Nahuel Mosse

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: node --test --test-force-exit --test-concurrency=4 tests/api.test.mjs tests/cli.test.mjs tests/findings.test.mjs tests/fixtures.test.mjs tests/origin-host-contract.test.mjs tests/package.test.mjs tests/parity.test.mjs tests/review-fixes.test.mjs
